# Agent Handover Template — HANDOVER

> **How to use:** Copy this file into `docs/handovers/` as `HDO-NNN_<TASK-ID>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md` (next free HDO number — see `docs/handovers/README.md`). Fill every section. Do **not** edit this master template. See `docs/12_AGENT_HANDOVER.md` for the policy.

---

## Metadata

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **HDO ID** | HDO-NNN |
| **Task ID(s)** | TASK-XXX (see docs/11_TASK_MANAGEMENT.md) |
| **Agent** | <your identity / session> |
| **Date** | YYYY-MM-DD |
| **Milestone** | MS-XX (see docs/09_PROJECT_ROADMAP.md) |
| **Work status** | Complete / Interim |
| **Changelog entry** | CHG-NNN (docs/13_PROJECT_CHANGELOG.md) |
| **Prerequisites for next agent** | <documents to read first> |

---

## 1. Summary

*3–5 sentences: what was done, current state, what happens next.*

## 2. Files Modified

| File (repo-root-relative) | Change | Reason |
|---------------------------|--------|--------|
| `path/to/file` | created / modified / deleted | why |

## 3. Work Completed

*Deliverables against the task description; evidence (links to docs, tasks, IDs).*

## 4. Remaining Work

*Ordered next steps; what is unfinished and why.*

## 5. Known Problems

*Open defects / risky areas / unfinished corners — with severity and where they manifest.*

## 6. Recommendations

*Concrete suggestions for the next agent and the reviewer.*

## 7. Architecture Decisions

*Decisions made during this task; cite ADR IDs (docs/14_DECISION_LOG.md) or mark "none".*

## 8. Risks

*New or changed risks; cite RISK IDs (docs/15_RISK_REGISTER.md) or mark "none".*

## 9. Future Improvements

*Ideas deliberately not done now; suggest as tasks on the board (docs/11_TASK_MANAGEMENT.md).*

## 10. Lessons Learned

*What future agents should know (process, tools, content, collaboration).*
